meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: 当没有专门的工作流匹配时，Claude 创作或编辑 HyperFrames 视频合成，用于较长或多场景作品、品牌片、蒙太奇等。它会先检查更新，再按项目状态执行流程，并加载媒体、Figma、动画等参考。
howto.when: 当没有专门的工作流匹配，或 BRIEF.md 将 flow 设为 companion 时触发。适用于较长或多场景影片、品牌片、蒙太奇等创作或编辑；新创作需先经 hyperframes 路由。

say.text: 帮我做一个 30 秒品牌宣传片，多场景，带旁白。
say.note: 触发新建项目流程，先写 BRIEF 再构建。

say.text: 把现有项目里的第三场景改成静态循环。
say.note: 作为具体编辑直接处理，不改动其余部分。

say.text: 用 companion 方式，基于这段素材做自由混剪。
say.note: 你会以导演身份参与共创，逐步对齐设计。

howto.what_en: When no specific workflow fits, Claude authors or edits HyperFrames compositions for long/multi-scene videos, brand reels, montages, etc. It checks updates, follows project state, loads media/Figma/animation refs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized workflow matches, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. For long/multi-scene videos, brand reels, montages, etc.; fresh creation routes via hyperframes.

say_en.text: Create a 30s brand promo, multi-scene with narration.
say_en.note: Starts a new project and writes a brief first.

say_en.text: Change scene 3 of the current project to a static loop.
say_en.note: Handled as a specific edit without rework.

say_en.text: Make a freeform remix from this footage, using companion flow.
say_en.note: You'll co-create and refine the design together.
